content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Christopher Myers (E012)
Requested: write access to Source Code

Facts:
- Employment type: contractor
- Role: Analyst
- Security training: basic (confirmed by Security)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Christopher has basic security training, not advanced. So the maximum for him is read.

Requested level: write. Requested level (write) is above maximum (read). So grant the maximum: read.

Also, the Source Code system is owned by the Engineer role. Christopher is an Analyst, not Engineer, but that matters for full-time admin. Contractors never get admin anyway.

Decision: read.
